preconditions.description: The length of the string Zvonko wrote down is between 1 and 200000, inclusive.
The string S contains exactly L lowercase letters of the English alphabet.

postconditions.description: The output is either zero or a length between 1 and L, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == 0 or (S[i:i+output] in S[j:j+output] for some i != j)
postconditions.description: The output is the length of the longest string that appears at least twice in the input string S.
